name: Chinaza Dynamic Filter AI Video
blurb: One photo, and you lean in, sing it, and point at the camera.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Bring the photo to life and keep everyone in it exactly as photographed: same faces, hair, clothes and place. They start standing still facing the camera, then lean right into the lens singing along to an upbeat pop chorus with big open-mouthed grins, throw both arms out wide, lean back laughing, point a finger straight up at the camera on the beat, fire finger guns at the lens and finish clapping their hands together. Handheld phone-camera feel that pushes in as they lean forward, natural light, one continuous take, vertical video. Upbeat sing-along pop music in the audio. No text, no logos, no watermark.
